description: The Avikote AV 800 is a Portland cement-based, spray and/or trowel applied product. Only the addition of water at the jobsite is required for application.
advantages: Fire Tested: Tested in accordance with Underwriters Laboratories, Inc. UL 1709 and ASTM E 119 (UL 263); investigated by UL for exterior use.

Durability: Avikote AV 800 has been tested for Coefficient of Thermal Expansion, Compressive Strength, Hardness, and other properties in accordance with API Guidelines (Publication 2218) and ASTM procedures.
Pumping equipment - Moyno, Rotor Stator, Piston or Hydraulic
Weatherability: Avikote AV 800 is formulated with ingredients that enhance its ability to resist weather and freeze thaw cycling.
notFor: Use on aluminum or other non-steel surfaces
mixing: approximately 11.5 liters (3 US gals) per bag
storage: The material shall be kept dry until ready for use.
